Products must be used only as intended and according to any instructions, warnings, manuals, labels, or manufacturer guidance. We are not responsible for misuse, improper installation, unauthorized modification, or failure to follow instructions.

By placing an order, you represent that your information is accurate, you are authorized to use the payment method, you are old enough to purchase under applicable law, and the order is for lawful use.

Shipping is governed by our Shipping Policy. Returns and refunds are governed by our No Returns and Refund Policy. We do not accept buyer-remorse returns or exchanges at launch. Do not send products back to the sender, supplier, package address, or any address found online. Customer accounts are optional unless otherwise stated.

Damaged, defective, wrong, missing, unshipped, or materially inaccurate orders should be reported to support so we can review the issue and offer an appropriate resolution where required or approved.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, exemplary, or punitive damages, including lost profits, lost data, delivery delays, or business interruption.
